name: Consumer Protection Commission
brand_truth: The public's referee when a business will not put things right: it logs, reviews, reaches out to the business and keeps you updated.
buyer: Bahamian consumers let down by a shop, repair or service, mostly on phones; site buyer is CPC leadership / Ministry comms.

design.signature: Receipt stamped with the CPC's real 4-stage process (sticky scrollytelling) + 4-step complaint builder sending to WhatsApp/email

current_site_findings: No website of its own; only a Facebook page.
Directories show old numbers (393-7795/6/7) instead of 604-9020 / WhatsApp 357-7898.
Email domain cpcbahamas.gov.bs has no website behind it.
Complaint guidance scattered across Facebook posts.
No structured way to send a complete complaint with proof.
pitch_line: People who want to complain about a business can't find you online beyond Facebook; this site turns your own advice into a four-step complaint that lands on your WhatsApp complete, with proof attached.
assumptions: 'Bank record of the payment' from a truncated post
Builder complaint categories and 'what you want' line are generic
notes: Government agency: pitch to the Executive Director / Ministry. No photos used. Concept footer states it is not an official Government website. Confirm whether a separate Consumer Affairs Department still handles some complaints (consumeraffairs.gov.bs exists).
